space.name: Kitting Domain Layout 4
space.notes: Foreseeable-task fixture (scenario_s04_01). One human run in five script parts: (1) an assigned delivery with a 1209 cm approach (positive control); (2) a walk from the kitting table to the coffee machine, >= 49.6 deg off every task target seen from the table; (3) a walk to the A/C switch ac_switch_1 (the waypoint wander_0 until F47b, retyped at the same coordinates so the scripted ac_activation instance is well typed), which lies on the straight line from the coffee machine to shelf_6 (the human heads toward a shelf it will use later); (4) the delivery from shelf_6; (5) the exit walk go_to(corner_SE) (Track 2.5, docs/assumptions.md 1.1). One A/C switch, the V1 rule (T-K part 1, AM18): ac_switch_0 and ac_switch_2 were removed on 4 October 2026 (AM19), and with ac_switch_2 the script's walk to it. The coffee machine sits alone south of the table; every shelf is on the east or west edge. Every target is >= 50 deg off the script part 1 heading. No obstacles. The ac_switch object uses the type string ac_activation's parameter_types asks for ('ac_switch').

env_objects.notes: Shared delivery sink, top centre. Script part 2 starts here.
Human's first delivery (script part 1). Approach from (100, 550): 1209 cm, bearing -150.3 deg; every other target is >= 50 deg off that heading.
Human's last delivery (script part 4). Script part 3's A/C switch, ac_switch_1, lies on the coffee_machine_0 -> shelf_6 line, 40% of the way.
Robot task 1 (cheapest from its SW start).

Robot task 3, the most expensive from the table, so it is done last and keeps the robot busy until ~375 ticks - the IR is only called while the robot has tasks (I1 7.12). Undelivered during the human's script part 4, where it is 17 deg off the heading (prior-off decoy; inadmissible prior-on).

Script part 2 target. From the kitting table: bearing -93.1 deg, 751 cm; nearest task-target bearing from there is shelf_5 at -43.5 deg (49.6 deg off). x = -40 keeps the walk off the x = 0 zone boundary.

The layout's one A/C switch. Script part 3's walk end (was the waypoint wander_0; retyped as an AC switch in F47b so that scenario_s04_01's scripted ac_activation is well typed - same coordinates). Exactly on the coffee_machine_0 -> shelf_6 line (t = 0.4): the human heads toward shelf_6 for 398 cm, stops at the switch, then walks on to shelf_6 for item_6 (script part 4). Since F47b it IS a hypothesis (ac_activation(ac_switch_1)).
